resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Kresek-based Forest Lookouts page give 10 feet; Hartig's 1981 history and the 2016 Clearwater National Forest list give 20 feet. The record keeps 3.0 m (10 ft); the story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Height is disputed (10 ft vs 20 ft); the record's 3.0 m follows the majority. Burned (1934) is the sources' word; the record's 'destroyed' is looser but not wrong, so no correction. No source describes the site today. Access is not documented. The 2016 list gives elevation 5012 ft and places the lookout about 5 miles from Canyon RS. A Facebook post and a 1933 photo credit surfaced in search (Owen Johnson, Bill Dennison on the catwalk) but were not read, so they are not used.
